questions.question: What is the mass of the new vector boson?
questions.reason: 10 MeV is a common light-mediator benchmark; the description says only 'light' and gives no mass.

questions.question: What is the coupling of the vector boson to the left-handed electron-neutrino current, g_nu^{ee}?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a conventional light-Z' benchmark coupling; the description gives no coupling value or flavor structure.

questions.question: What is the coupling of the vector boson to the left-handed muon-neutrino current, g_nu^{mm}?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a conventional light-Z' benchmark coupling; the description gives no coupling value or flavor structure.

questions.question: What is the coupling of the vector boson to the left-handed tau-neutrino current, g_nu^{tt}?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a conventional light-Z' benchmark coupling; the description gives no coupling value or flavor structure.
